scientific_integrity: Proof is analytic; the finite numerical tests are only corroboration. Classical orthant and occupation identities are explicitly credited. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only one preselected zero-threshold sign bit
Independent centered Gaussian prequantization noise whose variance is eta times the state variance at the sampling time
Prior-specific mean-square occupation functional, not deterministic worst-case quadrature
No claim for alternative thresholds, nonlinear adaptive protocols, multiple observations, or other noise kernels
title: Exact one-bit optimal sampling for Brownian occupation under relative Gaussian noise
